bullet: Docker-mode root and the cookie (`F16.docker-root-cookie`), known bug.
script:
DK=$(control-agent-server launch --new --name f16-docker --env OH_CONVERSATION_RUNTIME=docker --print-run)
trap 'control-agent-server stop --run "$DK" >/dev/null' EXIT
Z=00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000f6
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Z/workspace/" --run "$DK" --expect 404 --check detail eq 'Conversation not found'
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Z/workspace" --run "$DK" --expect 404 --check detail eq 'Conversation not found'
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Z/workspace/" --run "$DK" --auth none --expect 401
control-agent-server api POST /api/auth/workspace-session --run "$DK" --jar qa-f16-docker --expect 204
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Z/workspace/" --run "$DK" --auth none --jar qa-f16-docker --expect 404 --save F16.docker-root-cookie/slash
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Z/workspace" --run "$DK" --auth none --jar qa-f16-docker --expect 404 --save F16.docker-root-cookie/slashless  # bug
control-agent-server stop --run "$DK"
failed_command: control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Z/workspace" --run "$DK" --auth none --jar qa-f16-docker --expect 404 --save F16.docker-root-cookie/slashless
